resources.string: Cucuto vibration prompt
Ask an AI

Auto already makes a vibration from each clip\'s loudness, with no work. For one that hits the beats, copy this sound\'s details into an AI chat of your choice (attach the sound too if it takes audio), then paste its answer back here and play it. Cucuto itself sends nothing anywhere.
Copy for AI
Paste pattern
Use Auto instead
Pattern pasted. Play it, then save it.
Pattern pasted. Some events were moved to leave 50 ms after each tap, or dropped to end within 5 seconds. Play it, then save it.
That pattern doesn\'t fit
Tell the AI what\'s wrong and ask it for a corrected pattern.
OK
The clipboard has no text. Copy the AI\'s answer first.
The pattern
Event %d
Event %1$d, point %2$d
There\'s no pattern in what you copied. Copy the AI\'s whole answer, or just the JSON part that starts with { or [.
This pattern\'s mode is \"%s\". Only custom patterns, with events, can be pasted.
The pattern has no events. It needs at least one.
The pattern has too many events. The limit is %d.
Event %d needs either a \"preset\" or an \"envelope\", not both.
%1$s has a field Cucuto doesn\'t know: \"%2$s\".
%1$s: \"%2$s\" must be a whole number of milliseconds, not %3$s.
%1$s: \"%2$s\" must be a number from %3$d to %4$d, not %5$s.
Event %1$d uses the preset \"%2$s\". Use CLICK, TICK or LOW_TICK.
Event %1$d\'s envelope needs 1 to %2$d points, and it has %3$d.
Event %d\'s envelope must end with intensity 0, so the vibration stops.
Event %d starts before the one above it. Events must be sorted by start time (\"at\").
Event %1$d starts at %2$d ms, but the swell before it lasts until %3$d ms.
The pattern lasts %1$d ms. The limit is %2$d ms.
